purpose: Machine-readable source governance linking agent citizenship to Git. This is the contract that cynic-protocol::source_policy and cynic-protocol::source_control enforce. Rules here are authoritative; prose in protocols/ is projection.

sovereign_candidate.fallback_note: 10.10.10.119 is the BUILDER (LXC) that only mirrors the SSOT, not the Forgejo SSOT itself. Resolve the sovereign remote by observed URL against canonical_host, never by local remote name.
notes: Forgejo SSOT lives on a separate Proxmox VM (10.10.10.101, FQDN forgejo.synapse.cynic).
The builder (10.10.10.119, cynic-builder.synapse.cynic) builds from the SSOT; it is not the source of truth.
Resolve forgejo.synapse.cynic dynamically via Synapse DNS/WireGuard; never hardcode the IP as transport identity.
Reconcile order: cortex -> forgejo(SSOT) -> github(relay mirror).
GitHub is a vitrine/mirror only. Force-push is acceptable here (relay, not authority).
Never create PRs or promote merges here; the SSOT owns PRs.
admit_source_change blocks any SourceChangeProposal whose intent is not conformant.
One agent = one isolated worktree + one branch agent/<id>/<scope>.
admit_source_stage(SovereignCommit) refuses promotion to any protected_ref and to non-conforming branch names.
Promotion to main happens only through the merge bot / PR flow, never a direct agent push.
Agents MUST work in a git worktree, never directly on a checked-out trunk in the primary checkout.
The branch name MUST match agent_branch_template for the claiming agent.
cynic source sync handles cortex->forgejo. Release bot handles forgejo->github relay.
GitHub receives force-push mirror only; it is never the source of a PR.

rules: Forgejo (canonical_host) is the sovereign SSOT; the builder (10.10.10.119) is a mirror, not authority.
Never push directly to a protected ref; use a PR / merge bot.
Every commit intent must be a conformant Conventional Commit.
Every agent works on agent/<id>/<scope> in an isolated worktree.
Claims store schema is cynic.agent_claims.v2 (not v1).
The local .agent-claims.json is a cache; the kernel store is authoritative when reachable.
